expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] Under the expectation's rules, subagent-prompt-02.md is the only fix check, and it passes: it only asks to run the two repros and report whether they still reproduce ("Judge only these two findings"). Every other saved prompt counts as an independent review, and three of them break the rule. (1) subagent-prompt-04.md contains both repro names and also the review skill and a commit range ("/code-review high on main..feature/search-api (6a70bbd..6746708)"), so the rules make it an independent review. Its text says there were earlier issues and calls this a second round: "R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row on every page boundary...", "R1-2 (medium): LIKE wildcards in the search term aren't escaped...", "confirm whether each finding below still reproduces", "review-round2.md". (2) subagent-prompt-05.md has no repro name, so it is an independent review. It says "both repros exit 1 at round-1 87fe0d8, exit 0 'does not reproduce' at 6746708", which describes earlier issues as fixed. (3) subagent-prompt-01.md contains both repro names and the commit range "main..feature/search-api", so it is an independent review. It says "scribe/setup agent for a review round", "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent" and "Round-1 findings". The actual reviewer prompt, subagent-prompt-03.md, is clean ("/code-review high on main..feature/search-api ... Write the full review"). But the scribe prompts that store prompt text verbatim, 01, 04 and 05, still count as independent reviews and contain round, prior-issue and fixed language, so the expectation fails.
